title: Shell Lubricants
description: Comprehensive range of Shell automotive and industrial lubricants for optimal performance.

details.fullDescription: Shell's portfolio includes Shell Helix engine oils, Shell Advance for motorcycles, Shell Rimula for heavy-duty diesel, Shell Gadus greases, Shell Tellus hydraulic fluids, and Shell Omala gear oils.

title: Mobil Lubricants
description: Advanced synthetic and conventional lubricants including Mobil 1 and Mobil Delvac.

details.fullDescription: Mobil offers Mobil 1 synthetic engine oils, Mobil Super conventional oils, Mobil Delvac for heavy-duty diesel, Mobil DTE hydraulic fluids, Mobilgear, and Mobil SHC synthetic lubricants.

title: Castrol Lubricants
description: Premium "Liquid Engineering" solutions with Castrol EDGE and MAGNATEC technologies.

details.fullDescription: Castrol's range includes Castrol EDGE full-synthetic, Castrol MAGNATEC with intelligent molecules, Castrol GTX, Castrol VECTON for heavy-duty diesel, and industrial fluids.

title: GP (IPOL) Lubricants
description: IPOL brand automotive and industrial lubricants including metal working fluids.

details.fullDescription: GP Petroleums' IPOL range includes automotive engine oils, hydraulic oils, gear oils, spindle oils, turbine oils, metal working fluids, and specialty greases.
